summary: The selected design basis remains in the durable architecture record; rendered observations are planned and not yet run.

criteria.text: Give the local chat its first responsive visual direction from AD-1 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, section Design system and tokens. Use page #f5f2eb, panel #ffffff, dark panel #212f3d, accent #4f66bf, focus #344e9c, and content maximum 72rem; the dark canvas is #18222e. Observe the conversation list and active message thread at 390x844 and 1440x1000 in light and dark themes, with no horizontal overflow, an accent marker on the selected conversation, and visible keyboard focus. The browser command is planned, not yet run. Serves R-1.

Preserve local conversation selection, message display, and sending: selecting either seeded conversation changes the active thread, sending non-empty text appends it to that thread, and empty text is ignored. Confirm by node --test; pass when TC-CHAT passes. Serves R-2.

steps.task: Design the local chat using the selected direction, and preserve conversation/message behavior (C1-C2).
steps.proof: UI_DIAGNOSTIC=1 node scripts/check-chat-browser.cjs --light-page '#f5f2eb' --dark-page '#18222e' --panel '#ffffff' --dark-panel '#212f3d' --accent '#4f66bf' --focus-color '#344e9c' --content-max 72rem --dark-class theme-dark && npm test
